newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns Pi ratings to Japanese shipping firms.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Pi ratings to Japanese shipping firms.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had assigned a BBB pi rating to Nippon Yusen KK and BB pi ratings to Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha Ltd.

Nippon Yusen's rating reflected the company's relatively stable financial performance despite the competitive, cyclical and currency-sensitive nature of the Japanese shipping industry, S&P said in a statement.

Mitsui O.S.K.'s rating reflected its aggressive fleet investment strategy, resulting in high debt usage, as well as its vulnerability to industry competition, cyclicality and currency fluctuations, S&P said.
Kawasaki Kisen's rating reflected the limited scale and scope of the company's operations compared with major industry peers which makes it more vulnerable to industry competition, S&P said.

The "pi" or public information ratings were recently introduced by S&P. The "pi" subscript following the rating is to show capital market participants that the ratings are based on public information.
